title: Lenticular
description: A lenticular flip card of Beatles covers: ridged plastic over two interlaced sleeves, so tilting Rubber Soul turns it into Revolver right there in the plastic. Tap the card and it flips over to the next pair.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: the view angle through each ridge picks the cover, with the banding, fringing and sheen of a cheap flip card, and a tap that turns the whole card to the next pair.
